C1151.title: European Parliament Resolution Bans Police Use of Public Facial Recognition, Citing Algorithmic Discrimination Outweighing Benefits
C1151.summary: On October 6, 2021, the European Parliament passed a resolution prohibiting police use of mass facial recognition and other AI tools in public spaces. The resolution noted higher misidentification rates for ethnic minorities, LGBT individuals, the elderly, and women, highlighting algorithmic bias. Large-scale deployment in law enforcement was deemed to undermine fundamental rights. The resolution
